title: Penn State researchers say parents should be aware of online gaming dangers - NewsBreak
text: (WHTM) — While protecting children is a top priority for most parents — many don’t know the dangers that online gaming can present. “My research is about child safety in video games,” said Yubo Kou. Thanks for signing up! Watch for us in your inbox. Subscribe Now “Child safety is definitely a very important topic,” added Xinning Gui. Kou and Gui are assistant professors at Penn State University. “We have been focusing on child safety in Roblox,” Kou said. Through research, Kou and Gui found that some of the most popular online games, like Roblox, are largely unmoderated – which could pose safety risks for some kids. “Roblox is a very unique environment because it is an integrated environment that invites child players to interact with each other and also to create video games for others to play,” Kou said. “This is a unique environment in the sense that, many of the games are unmoderated and then many of the game contain quite harmful designs, and then those harmful designs can present severe safety risks to other child players.” They said parents should be aware of these dangers. Gui said, “I think the first and probably most important step is to actually play the games themselves in order for, you know, parents to understand what’s going on here.” Another tip for parents is to simply talk to their children about the games they are playing and the dangers that could be presented.
